_comment: Descriptive names for the Stage 5 route groups, chosen by the user AFTER inspecting the development-period summaries (spec 9.11.3: names are interpretations to verify, not predefined labels). The build applies a name only if the frozen pipeline reproduces exactly these memberships; otherwise it stops.

0.name: Higher-demand, seven-day routes
0.basis: median 7,044 weekday rides; weekday CV median 0.146; 63 of 67 have Saturday and Sunday/holiday service; median trip 53.6 min; median 37.8 rides per scheduled hour

1.name: Lower-demand routes, often with limited or no weekend service
1.basis: median 1,040 weekday rides; weekday CV median 0.224; 26 of 56 have no Saturday and 32 of 56 no Sunday/holiday service; median trip 29.7 min; median 26.5 rides per scheduled hour

caveats: Names describe each group's typical member; ranges overlap (group 1's busiest route, 4,095 weekday rides, is busier than group 0's quietest, 1,925; rides per scheduled hour overlap 13-60 vs 24-51).
A group is not a performance grade; group numbers are not an order of efficiency. A lower-demand route may serve coverage obligations.
Separation is moderate (silhouette 0.38; k = 2 chosen by the fixed rule, a near tie with k = 3 at 0.383).
Fitted on the development period only; later observations do not change memberships or names.
